summary: Backend regression tests for YOURFM token refresh, genre adherence, no-429 discovery, and bumper generation. 9/10 tests passed. All P0 bug fixes (token auto-refresh, batched artist lookups, strict genre profile filter, classic-rock block for -core stations) are confirmed working. The only failure is unrelated: the Gemini model 'gemini-2.0-flash' used in /api/bumpers/generate is deprecated and returns 404 from Google.

critical.issue: Returns 500 because model 'gemini-2.0-flash' is no longer available. Google returns: 'This model models/gemini-2.0-flash is no longer available.' The .with_model('gemini', 'gemini-2.0-flash') call (server.py line 922) must be upgraded (e.g. 'gemini-2.5-flash' or current supported model).

action_items: Replace 'gemini-2.0-flash' in /app/backend/server.py (line ~922 inside /api/bumpers/generate) with a current Gemini model name such as 'gemini-2.5-flash'. The litellm error message confirms model deprecation.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1082 lines (>700 threshold) — should be split into routers (spotify_router.py, bumpers_router.py, weather_router.py, etc.) for maintainability.

/api/spotify/tracks: artist_top_tracks (line 562) is called per-artist in a loop — currently limited to 5 artists which is fine, but if a station grows to 20+ artists this would re-introduce N+1. Consider documenting the 5-artist cap.

/api/spotify/tracks: the genre_matches_target() uses substring matching (line 578: 'tg in ag or ag in tg'). Short genres like 'pop' would match 'pop punk' / 'k-pop' / 'pop rock' — acceptable for now but worth noting as a soft-filter.
blocked_genres for 'pop' family includes 'metal' (line 490) but not 'rap'/'trap' — pop stations could still pull rap-pop crossover. Not a regression, just inconsistent with rock blocking all hip-hop.
Bumper generate endpoint has a hard-coded model name (gemini-2.0-flash) with no environment-variable override — when model deprecates, a code change is required. Consider GEMINI_MODEL env var.
ElevenLabs voices endpoint returns 200 with empty list + 'message' field when no custom voices. Frontend must handle this — backend behaviour is reasonable.
test_credentials: Spotify token auto-refreshed from MongoDB radio_app_db.spotify_tokens (user_id 'default_user'). No app login required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Spotify/genre fixes are verified GREEN (no 429, no classic-rock leak, 30+ tracks in <2s, token auto-refresh works). Only bumper-generate is broken due to deprecated Gemini model — once the model name is updated, rerun: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_spotify_bumpers.py::TestBumpers -v. The test test_bumper_generate_references_tracks asserts that the AI text references at least one of: 'bad omens', 'limits', 'spiritbox', 'the void'.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Google deprecated 'gemini-2.0-flash'. litellm propagates the 404 NotFoundError. Hard-coded in server.py line 922: .with_model('gemini', 'gemini-2.0-flash').
rca_of_the_issue.reproduction: POST /api/bumpers/generate with any valid payload + real ElevenLabs voice_id → response: 500 {'detail': 'Error generating bumper: ... GeminiException ... This model models/gemini-2.0-flash is no longer available.'}
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Change model identifier to a current Gemini model, e.g. .with_model('gemini', 'gemini-2.5-flash'). Optionally make the model configurable via env var GEMINI_MODEL.
